acceptanceCriteria: SERVICE500-007 is delivered: each helper has a distinct manifest, unit and runtime identity, one foreground spawn under the shared fence, verified descendants before acknowledgement, and retirement of prior helper trees before restart, resume or reinstall.
`run-helper` and optional bounded service logging are delivered, with byte, sink, backpressure and drop bounds documented.
Runtime restart-debt charging for helpers is delivered or explicitly reported NOT_OBSERVED, never as zero debt.
Install stops refusing helpers with UNSUPPORTED only after the above pass focused tests and independent review; platform qualification stays with V1-0697.
body: Deferred by the owner on 2026-10-05 when issue #500 was closed. The #500 runtime slice (V1-0697, merged on main by 618680492cf8) delivers optional install, status and uninstall, stop and drain, the shared launch fence and the legacy stop file. Helpers are refused UNSUPPORTED at install, and `run-helper`, service logging and runtime restart-debt charging are not delivered (docs/specs/corvint-tasks-user-service-v0.md, SERVICE500-007 and its Traceability row). This ticket holds that deferred helper work. Disposable Darwin/Linux platform qualification remains on V1-0697.

completion.reason: Delivered: Linux-only service helpers; service install accepts them on Linux and returns UNSUPPORTED elsewhere. The six open questions were decided fail-closed by the orchestrator under the owner's delegation. Codex review findings were repaired. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-05-v1-0804-service-helpers.md at 7b60d52d. Verified at 7b60d52d (merge of beamfall/corvint#613); CI on #613 green (go-product shards 0-3, go-interop, doc-gates, artifact-integrity, containment). Owner accepted with qualification NOT_RUN on 2026-10-05: platform qualification (tracked by V1-0697), make gate and tests outside the focused set are NOT_RUN; follow-up V1-0818. The acceptance record docs/build-log/2026-10-05-v1-0804-accepted-not-run.md lands with the batch PR from claude/batch-2026-10-05b.
